label: Informed postcolonial critique of Western epistemic representation of Global South women
description: Building alongside Spivak's critique of discursive colonization, Mohanty demonstrated in "Under Western Eyes" how Western feminist texts homogenize diverse women across the Global South into a singular victimized subject.
dialecticalTension: Applies postcolonial deconstruction directly to sociological methodology.
historicalContext: Postcolonial feminist wave of the mid-1980s.

label: Adapted Foucauldian discourse power analysis to feminist colonial scholarship
description: Mohanty utilized Foucault's power/knowledge analytic to show that Western academic categories are not neutral descriptions, but discursive acts producing geopolitical hierarchy.
dialecticalTension: Redirects Foucauldian genealogy toward transnational anti-imperialist solidarity.
historicalContext: Under Western Eyes (1984) and Feminism Without Borders (2003).

label: Prefigured anti-Eurocentric critiques of liberal autonomy norms in transnational feminism
description: Mohanty's warning against judging Global South women's agency by Western liberal-individualist yardsticks laid methodological groundwork for Saba Mahmood's ethnography of non-liberal Islamic piety.
dialecticalTension: Opens feminist philosophy to historically situated, non-Western modalities of agency.
historicalContext: From "Under Western Eyes" (1984) to Politics of Piety (2005).

citations.author: Saba Mahmood
citations.work: Politics of Piety: The Islamic Revival and the Feminist Subject
